svg.title: Signals and C/N0 along a high Earth orbit
svg.desc: Signals along one high Earth orbit (perigee 497 km, apogee 58622 km, period 18.8 h), from a real run of engine v0.39.0 on scenarios/gnss-ssv-heo.toml, band L1. Top: the best carrier-to-noise density among the signals in view, against the 20 dB-Hz threshold. Middle: the number of signals in view from all constellations, from 4 to 55 along the sampled points. Of the links received, 2252 came through a main lobe and 696 through sidelobes, using a labelled parametric stand-in pattern, not any system's measured pattern. Median PDOP 67, 95th percentile 358. MODELLED: a modelled study from stated inputs, not a measurement and not a service-volume claim for any system. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
